The changeovers it missed

22 game endings you confirmed are real, that the detector said nothing about. Each one is re-run here so you can see what it was looking at: the table is outlined, and every person it considered is boxed.

picked as the near player picked as the far player would have picked, refused as too similar in size to someone else looked at, not picked too far from the table the table

Why nothing fired

12saw it and refused
8read them as the same
1swap was likelier, not by enough
1put the change elsewhere

These are computed from the evidence, not guessed, and they need opposite fixes. Could not read the players means the rallies around the break never gave a usable read on both ends — look at whether the right people are boxed. Read them as the same means it saw both players clearly and their colours did not appear to swap. Saw it and refused means the change was found and did not clear the confidence bar.
